name: Lac de Mantasoa

centre.what: open water in the middle of the lake, about 190 m from the nearest shore: a point of calculation, of no importance on the ground

grid.columns: A to Z, then AA to AN, as a spreadsheet letters them; rows 1 to 52 south to north

zone.what: the lake as mapped (OpenStreetMap relation 1154835) with its islands, plus a band of shore 100 m inland from the mapped waterline

terrain.source: Copernicus GLO-30 DEM (30 m, 1 arc-second, a radar surface model), cubic-resampled to 20 m
terrain.kind: DSM: heights include tree canopy (pine and eucalyptus plantation) and roofs; the lake is a flat surface, with no depths
terrain.licence: Copernicus DEM GLO-30, ESA / Airbus, free and open

features.source: OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL), via the Overpass API
features.names: Malagasy and French exactly as mapped, which is what the atlas prints; the lake is given its established French name
features.building_keep: buildings within building_keep_m of the mapped waterline, and every building on the sheets of the village and Laborde works, are listed singly in features.bin; the rest are counted per square

units: metres throughout: contours on the atlas are in metres (10 m, heavy every 50 m); the tools answer in metres and feet

cover.licence: ESA WorldCover project 2021, contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data, CC BY 4.0

check.what: the lake surface at the most open water, about 360 m from the nearest shore; the line should end WATER (in the Zone)

lake.surface_note: the flat lake surface in the Copernicus GLO-30 model (median 1385.0 m, spread under 0.5 m): the level when the radar flew (TanDEM-X, 2011-2015), not a fixed level
lake.bathymetry: none: no depths are known or packed

atlas.title: LAC DE MANTASOA
atlas.subtitle: MADAGASCAR · Atlas de terrain
atlas.centre_phrase: en pleine eau, à 200 m de la rive

declination.source: NOAA WMM-2025 for 27 Nov 2026 at 19.0093 S, 47.8789 E (the middle of the lake): 16.34 W, changing 0.09 W per year

atlas.pdf_title: Lac de Mantasoa : atlas de terrain
atlas.base: drawn from data in the manner of the Service Géographique de Madagascar / FTM sheets; no scanned survey sheet is used (none was found with both coverage of the lake and clear reuse rights)

sheets.rule: a 1 km sheet (4 x 4 squares) is in the atlas if it holds any water or shore band, or one of include_names; a left-out sheet shut in on all four sides by included sheets or the frame edge (at least three of them sheets) is added. Numbered in reading order from the north-west.
include_names: Ancienne résidence de Jean Laborde à Mantasoa
Ancien haut fourneau de Jean Laborde
